home: Founded on 1st September 2008; working consistently for 18+ years.
Primarily operates across Chandigarh and Mohali.
Founded and led by Isha Kakaria.
Supported by a team of 40+ like-minded members and enthusiasts from diverse fields and backgrounds.
A completely voluntary organisation, with members contributing their time, skills, and efforts selflessly.
Not financially supported or funded by the Government.
No salary, membership fee, or certification fee is charged.
Team contributes through cash or in-kind support for monthly events and social initiatives.
Organises monthly events, primarily on weekends.
Membership open for individuals aged 21 years and above, with no upper age limit.
Provides certified internships for individuals aged 18 years and above.
Recognised and awarded by the Government and various reputed platforms.
Conducts an Annual Award Ceremony to appreciate and recognise the best contributors of the team.
Takes pride in maintaining a culture of discipline, transparency, accountability, and open communication.
Visit the “What We Do” section to know more about our initiatives.
